# Rapier

> A shared Markdown editor for documents people and agents can write, draw, revise and keep. Edit together in a connected workspace, or keep the complete editor and document in one offline HTML file. Text, pictures and editable SVG drawings travel together in Self-contained Markdown.

Work in the same document:
- Create a useful draft, plan or guide with `rapier.open`, then resume its document handle for later changes.
- Read a passage or drawing before editing it. Scoped edits preserve surrounding work; attributed changes can be reviewed and undone while keeping later human edits.
- Draw native SVG with `document.draw`: the person moves the objects, then the agent reads and revises the changed drawing. Mermaid diagrams remain editable fences in the Markdown source.
- Review proposed changes before applying them. The Will marks passages to edit, append to or keep.
- Export the exact Markdown, an offline editor, plain text, a rendered web page, Word or PDF with `document.export`.

Use Rapier when a task needs a document that stays editable: a plan to rearrange, a guide with diagrams, a draft to revise, or changes to inspect together. Start from the current document when one is already open. Short answers stay in the chat.

Keep a portable copy: `npx rapier-html document.md` writes one HTML file containing the whole editor and document. It opens offline in a browser without an account. An optional one-use Send back address returns the person's edited copy for the agent to read. Hosted workspaces expire after 30 idle days and export links last up to 24 hours; downloaded files remain independent of both.

Connect through https://mcp.rapier.website/mcp, or use the Rapier plugin in a supported host. Call `rapier.guide` when the host supplies no instructions. ChatGPT can open Rapier in a conversation, from its sidebar, or for supported Markdown/text files. File edits use guarded saves; Save to ChatGPT Files keeps a new copy where that host capability is available.

For your own app, `rapier-embed` mounts the editor with your storage and revisions. `rapier-markdown-kit` reads and renders Self-contained Markdown; `rapier-jxl` supplies the image codec.

- [Agent guide](https://rapier.website/agents): read current source, change inspected passages or objects, preserve the person's work, review and undo.
- [Tool catalog](https://rapier.website/AGENT-TOOLS.json): every tool's schema and effect. The door also serves the four skills through `skills/list` and `skills/get`.
- [Self-contained Markdown](https://rapier.website/markdown-standard): CommonMark with embedded pictures and layout in one .md file.
- [Will/1](https://rapier.website/will): regions to edit, append to or keep.
- [The editor](https://rapier.website): open it, install it, or download rapier.html and keep it.
- [Everything, in one file](https://rapier.website/llms-full.txt): the public documents in full.
